protocol.selection: lowest mean final validation cross entropy across seeds; ties: fewer parameters, name
protocol.test_usage: final evaluation of all prespecified candidates after selection; no retuning
protocol.seed_variation: initialization and minibatch order, fixed data split

limits: Small easy historical dataset; no production or population-generalization claim.
Three seeds on one split do not estimate data-sampling uncertainty.
No group/time metadata: exact duplicate and row checks cannot exclude latent leakage.
Equal sample/update budgets do not mean equal FLOPs or wall time.
Uncalibrated softmax scores are not reliability guarantees.
Assistant-generated evidence does not establish independent learner mastery.

policy.name: wine-float64-lastbits-v1
policy.default: Exact types, structure, nonfloats and all unlisted floats; priors and count-derived metrics/summaries are exact. Object key order is irrelevant; array order is significant. Signed zeros are numerically equal only on allow-listed continuous paths; all unlisted floats retain encoding equality.
policy.strict_digest: Unmodified runtime_probe.result_digest; excludes only root created_at_utc and environment; signed zero encodings differ.
policy.limits: At most 8 adjacent finite binary64 representable steps is a predeclared diagnostic budget, not a derived error bound for iterative training, a count of differing mantissa bits, or a general platform guarantee. Validation checks the Wine schema and reported checks, not metric truth.
